description: backend/services/paper_trading_v2/repository.py::update_run_status (~984) issues UPDATE paper_v2.run SET status=%s ... WHERE run_id=%s with NO current-status predicate; rowcount!=1 only detects a missing row, not an illegal transition. A terminal FAILED run can be silently overwritten to SUCCEEDED by a finalize path holding a stale in-memory run object (live_session.py:1088 only does an in-Python if run.status != FAILED TOCTOU check; live_session.py:1435/1865 call update_run_status(SUCCEEDED) unconditionally). Additionally day_runner.py:754 and :1694 mark the PaperRun SUCCEEDED from an account/position snapshot WITHOUT asserting all reconciled orders are terminal (FILLED/CANCELLED/REJECTED). Scope note: the simulation_runtime submit_result_gate is already design-compliant (success authority = ledger facts) and MUST NOT be weakened; this bug is limited to PaperRun status-write integrity on the repository/day_runner/live_session path (root-cause B).
